post.text:
Inside Jets Arvell Reese v. David Bailey decision.

GM doesn’t trust Staff to tailor scheme to ensure proper utilization of Arvell Reese. When Jets change coaches after 2026, a new scheme / new voices could stunt Reese’s development. Scouting Staff doesn’t see semblance of a plan
